name: Green Iron Bracers
label: Quest
description: Green Iron Bracers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive! Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear. They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know?
How about green iron bracers, friend? Can you make me green iron bracers? If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes! These are exactly what I need! Such a lovely color, and they still leave my arms bare so you can see how strong they are! Perfect!
Here you are, friend. Here are your tickets - enjoy!
